answer: The cedar ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own zephyr record, and its own share of the whisper quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2727 identities would post 957 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
